ns2:course.label: Special Topics Junior
ns2:course.description: (HUMAN 297) Interdisciplinary seminar and tutorial in selected topics related to one of the options in the humanities major. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing and consent of humanities adviser (tutorial students must submit an Approved Learning Agreement to 270 Lincoln Hall, 702 S. Wright Street, Urbana, not later than the second week of the semester or the first week of the summer session).
